statement: The task of verification is easier than learning. For example, the family of all languages Le = {0, 1}|e| \ {e} with e ∈ {0, 1}+ is verifiable from arbitrary text but not automatically learnable from arbitrary text. However it is an open problem whether all automatic families satisfying Angluin’s tell-tale condition are automatically learnable from one-one texts, balanced texts and exponential texts.
